title: Unified live agent roster for 3D Lab, Harness and status views
user_story: As the researcher I see in 3D Lab exactly the agents that exist (configured roles, every agent the Harness created, Hermes, connected MCP clients) with their real states, updated live.

requirements.description: Roster lists the configured roles, Harness custom profiles and agent nodes of user-saved workflows (team nodes one agent per member; presets/templates excluded), Hermes, and MCP clients active within 30 minutes.
States come only from runtime records: running tool jobs (tool and job id), running chat turns, the latest Harness execution node statuses, and the Hermes runtime/gateway requests.
GET /api/agents/roster and SSE /api/agents/roster/stream (event roster whenever the digest changes).

nonfunctional: Snapshot digest stable when nothing changes
inputs: config, harness profiles/workflows/executions, runtime jobs, chat turns, MCP sessions, Hermes
outputs: Roster snapshot with counts and digest
acceptance_criteria: Harness-created agent count matches saved nodes/profiles

scenarios.expected: Every Harness agent counted, presets excluded, sync on change
Tool jobs mark agents busy with job links
Execution node failure becomes error state

recovery: Remove the roster endpoints; consumers fall back to their own sources. TASK-AGENT-ROSTER-662, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real config, harness files, execution records and API in disposable data; Hermes state and MCP sessions patched.

tdd.scope: RED: module missing 8/8 ERROR. GREEN: 8/8 PASS.
